en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a dense European town with steep‑roofed buildings and dormer windows surrounding an open central square. Beyond the town center lie rolling fields, scattered villas, and patches of woodland. Architectural details—tall narrow houses, slate roofs, and orderly facades—suggest a Central European, likely German, small city in the early 20th century. There is no visible caption or border text on the image itself.
